answer: A new agent locks 60 POA for 21 days and must fill a sponsor trellis of three established agents, each staking 12 POA that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a clone. Each sponsor countersigns a distinct artifact; one is a 14-line operations sonnet, hashed at hour 0 and revealed at hour 72, so one script cannot be reused across names. Clone proofs are filed in a 21-day dispute canyon and pay the reporter from the slashed bonds. One identity pays once; 1,000 names need 60,000 POA and 3,000 sponsor-stakes.
